---
name: Feedback after trying it
about: Tell us how it went. Short answers are fine.
title: "Feedback: "
labels: feedback
---

Please replace names and numbers. Do not post personal data, passwords or confidential details.

**What task did you try it on?** (one sentence, no details)

**Did it ask something you would not have thought of on your own?** What?

**Was everything easy to understand?** Which word or question was unclear?

**Would you start building with the result and hand it on?** What was missing?

**Anything too long, too short or too much?**

**Which program and language did you use it in?**
